name: Trading Multiple History
summary: NTM EV/EBITDA (or P/E) over time with the period mean, ±1σ / ±2σ shaded bands, current-value labels and an optional peer-median comparison.
summary_zh: NTM EV/EBITDA（或 P/E）历史走势：期间均值线、±1σ / ±2σ 阴影带、当前值标签，可叠加同业中位数对比。
description_zh: 投行“交易倍数历史”页的标准图。数据为时间序列（日期 + 目标公司倍数，可选同业中位数等对比列）；以回看期（lookback，默认全区间）计算均值和标准差，画出均值虚线与 ±1σ/±2σ 阴影带，右侧自动排布当前值胶囊标签和均值/σ 数值，互不重叠。用来判断当前估值相对历史区间是高还是低、相对同业是溢价还是折价（提示框给出溢价/折价与偏离均值的 σ 数）。支持滚轮/滑块缩放时间轴。
best_for: NTM EV/EBITDA or P/E history vs. own average and ±1σ
avoid_when: Fewer than ~20 observations (bands are not meaningful)
More than two series (use a line chart)
Comparing many companies' multiples at one date (use bar)

y.desc: Multiple of the subject company; mean and σ bands are computed on it

compare.desc: Comparison series, e.g. peer median (set null to hide)

lookback.desc: Years used to compute mean / σ (null = full history); bands span the same window

compareMean.desc: Also draw the comparison series' mean

endLabels.desc: Current-value pills and mean / σ labels at the right edge (collision-free)

premium.desc: Show premium / (discount) vs. the comparison series in the tooltip

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the y field format (else 0.0x)

legend.desc: Top-left legend (when a comparison series is shown)

zoom.desc: Compact slider + drag on the time axis; Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch zooms (options.wheelZoom: true for the plain wheel)

interactions: Crosshair tooltip with value, peer value, premium / (discount) and deviation from the mean in σ
Zoom and pan the time axis (slider, drag, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch)
